atten4.ptxt: When data communication is performed using the customer's own cellular phone, the communication status cannot be checked.

item.ptxt: The manual maintenance check performs a maintenance check of the in-vehicle unit (in-vehicle unit repair check and maintenance check after vehicle repair) and checks whether the member is registered with the center (at subscription, cancellation and contract change), and can switch from the emergency call disabled state to the enabled state.
The screen is an example display and may differ from the actual screen.

s3.ptxt: Check that the GPS mark is displayed on the current position screen.

atten4.ptxt: The manual maintenance check confirms that position information can be sent accurately. Therefore, avoid locations between buildings and indoors such as in a factory, and perform it in an open location where GPS can be received.

s3.ptxt: Press the "Info G" switch to display the information screen.
Select the "G-BOOK" tab on the information screen and press "Main Menu".
On the main menu screen, press and hold "(HELPNET) Maintenance Check" for 10 seconds or more.

list1.title: When using a Bluetooth cellular phone, refer to the owner's manual and make the following settings.

item.ptxt: Register and connect the cellular phone.
Select the manufacturer type that matches the cellular phone being used.

s3.ptxt: When connected to the center, data communication is performed first, and the current position of the vehicle, the fact that a manual maintenance check is being performed, and member registration with the center are checked.
After data communication is completed, the system enters call mode.
Talk with the center through the microphone, and check that the call can be made normally and that the reported position is correct.
If the screen shown in the illustration is displayed, perform the following operations.

item.ptxt: If the call was made normally and the reported position was confirmed to be correct, select "Yes" after the call ends.
If the call was not made normally or the reported position was not correct, select "No" to fail the manual maintenance check, and contact the G-BOOK Support Center.

atten4.ptxt: The screen shown in the illustration is displayed only if the HELPNET service start operation or the first manual maintenance check has not been completed normally.

s3.ptxt: Then, display the current position screen.
Select the "G-BOOK" tab on the information screen and check that the "HELPNET" switch is displayed.

atten4.ptxt: For diagnosis screen transitions and how to start diagnosis, refer to HDD Navigation System - Diagnosis System ().

s3.ptxt: Start diagnosis and display the service check screen. 。 (see )
Select "Service Information" on the service check screen to display the service information screen.
Select "HELPNET Call History" on the service information screen to display the HELPNET call history screen.

entry.ptxt: Displays the date and time of the call as year/month/day hour:minute

list1.title: Displays the result of communication with the HELPNET operation center as follows

item.ptxt: "OK": When communication with the center finished normally
"Failed": When communication with the center did not finish normally
"Interrupted": When communication with the center was interrupted
"Member Not Registered": When member registration has not been performed
If "Member Not Registered" is displayed, contact the customer and ask them to perform the service start operation.
If "Failed" or "Interrupted" is displayed, perform a manual maintenance check and check whether the call can be made normally.

If the manual maintenance check does not finish normally, inspect according to the instructions in the Problem Symptoms Table [Cannot connect to the center even when a manual maintenance check is performed]. (see )
